_comment: Dashboard 2: Failure & Defect Breakdown. CONFIRMED against a live RP 5.15.x instance: 'mostFailedTestCases' is NOT a valid widgetType -- use 'topTestCases'. Both 'topTestCases' and 'flakyTestCases' require widgetOptions.launchNameFilter (RP rejects creation otherwise with 'launchNameFilter should be specified for widget'); '%' (SQL LIKE wildcard) IS ACCEPTED at creation time, but in this sandbox returned EMPTY content (a specific launch name, e.g. 'Checkout API Tests', returned real per-test-case data). Until '%' is confirmed to populate, treat 'Top Failed Test Cases' as created-but-possibly-empty until a team edits launchNameFilter to one of their real launch names via the RP UI. 'topTestCases' additionally requires exactly ONE contentFields entry ('Only one content field could be specified'). 'uniqueBugTable' accepts the 'statistics$defects$<type>$total' fields shown below at creation time, but the exact sub-type tokens are project-configurable (Project Settings -> Defect Types; this sandbox's defaults are locators nd001/ti001/ab001/pb001/si001 for no_defect/to_investigate/automation_bug/product_bug/system_issue) -- confirm the data actually populates once failed items with defect types exist.

widgets.name: Top Failed Test Cases
widgets.description: Test cases that fail most often across recent launches with failures.

widgets.name: Defect Type Breakdown
widgets.description: Failures grouped by defect classification (product bug, automation bug, system issue, to investigate, no defect).

widgets.name: Flaky Test Cases
widgets.description: Top 10 test cases whose status flips between pass/fail across recent launches.
